title: Banks Act Guidance Note 5/2013 — Foreign Exchange Settlement Risk
enablingLegislation: Section 6(5) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Document issued by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision on
sections.text:
foreign exchange settlement risk
1.1
In February 2013, the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS)
released a document relating to FXSR, entitled "Supervisory Guidance for
Managing Risks Associated
with the Settlement of Foreign Exchange
Transactions"' The aforesaid document provides guidelines for, and
establishes sound practices applicable to, all banks.
'Available at http://www.bis.org/publ/bcbs241.htm.

This Office is currently in the process of updating its supervisory framework to
remain up to date with the latest international best practices, including the
latest developments regarding FXSR.
In future, as part of its Supervisory Review and Evaluation Process (SREP),
this Office will review the progress made by banks to incorporate the principles
and guidance set out in the aforesaid document issued by the BCBS into
banks' FXSR policies, processes and practices.
Banks are accordingly requested to assess their current policies, processes
and practices against the principles and guidance contained in the aforesaid
BCBS document related to FXSR.
Acknowledgement of receipt
Two additional copies of this guidance note are enclosed for use by your
institution's independent auditors. The attached acknowledgement of receipt,
duly completed and signed by both the chief executive officer of the institution
and the said auditors, should be returned to this Office at the earliest
convenience of the aforementioned signatories.
René van Wyk
Registrar of Banks
The previous guidance note issued was Guidance Note 4/2013, dated 23 July 2013.
